2026-10-14.title: BlackRock and Baillie Gifford bet big on Icon 3D printed homes

2026-10-14.title: Property Play: Saint-Gobain CEO Benoit Bazin on AI, data centers and the benefits of going 'multi-local'
2026-10-14.summary: With housing shortages and high costs squeezing real estate, how can the industry build better and faster? Saint-Gobain Chairman and CEO Benoit Bazin joins Diana Olick to discuss AI’s role in developing smarter materials, the data center boom, and why sustainable construction can deliver more value.

2026-10-14.title: OpenAI Says Staffer Arrested for Hidden Recording Device in Office
2026-10-14.summary: An employee at OpenAI was arrested and charged with using a hidden recording device in one of the company’s San Francisco offices, according to statements from the artificial intelligence company and the US Justice Department.

2026-10-14.summary: Shortages forced the company to turn away some AI and cloud business. Now it’s planning for 38 gigawatts of data center capacity to meet demand.

2026-10-14.title: Vista Equity CEO Smith on Growth of AI, Agentic Software
2026-10-14.summary: Robert F. Smith, Vista Equity Partners founder, chairman and CEO, talks about the growth of artificial intelligence, agentic software and the importance of learning how to use an AI agent. He speaks to Dani Burger at CAIS in Beverly Hills, California.  (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-14.title: Applied Materials CEO on Doubling Revenue Thanks To AI
2026-10-14.summary: Applied Materials CEO Gary Dickerson says he expects revenue to double over the next few years. He notes that Applied Materials had opened a $5 billion research and development center in Silicon Valley to speed development of next-generation chips. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-14.title: PSP’s Momei Qu on Anthropic’s Pre-IPO Investor Day
2026-10-14.summary: Ahead of Anthropic’s pre-IPO investor day, Momei Qu of PSP Growth says public-market investors may disagree over whether fast-growing AI companies deserve lower margins and heavy capital spending—or must prove stronger returns and profitability. Recent IPO setbacks, including a collapse in Asia and Aura’s withdrawal, illustrate the uncertainty facing both AI firms beyond Anthropic and companies outside the sector. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-14.title: Cloud Gaming and AI Threaten to Make Home Consoles Extinct
2026-10-14.summary: Games streamed over the internet will grow to a $38 billion market by 2035 and may eventually kill off the dedicated video-game console as a mass-market product, according to research from Bloomberg Intelligence.

2026-10-14.title: Why China Wants to Master the Robotic Hand
2026-10-14.summary: China is making a big bet on humanoid robots, with dexterous hands as its focus. It’s a key to building a stronger manufacturing base while addressing a slowly shrinking workforce. (Source: Bloomberg)

2026-10-14.title: Microsoft Reports $130 Billion in Data Center Leases

2026-10-14.summary: Advanced humanoid hardware is one of the strategic high-tech fields where China has an early lead over the US.

2026-10-14.title: AI Industry Not Ready For Coming Crisis, Says Mukunda
2026-10-14.summary: Leading AI executives are reportedly preparing for the possibility of a major AI-caused disaster within the next six to 12 months. AI systems have already been linked to multiple cybersecurity incidents, including breaches of outside systems and attacks affecting tens of thousands. Gautam Mukunda, Bloomberg Opinion Columnist & Lecturer at the Yale School of Management, explains why those incidents may be indicative of a much larger problem. (Source: Bloomberg)
